chunks: The two sajdahs of forgetfulness are after the taslim and before speaking.

The Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Abd Allah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from 'Ali عليه السلام, who said:

key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: the concluding taslim of the prayer
key_terms.السَّهْوِ: forgetfulness or inadvertent mistake in prayer

ai.seo_question: When are the two sajdahs of forgetfulness performed in prayer?
ai.summary: This report heading states the ruling that the two sajdahs of forgetfulness are performed after the taslim and before speaking. The provided text also includes the full sanad leading to Imam 'Ali عليه السلام.
